title: Currencies — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The currencies pay is made in. Each payroll area has a currency, and payroll rounds amounts to that currency's number of decimal places.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: DecimalCount
fields.html:
What it is. How many decimal places the currency uses.

Example. 3 for the Kuwaiti dinar

Why it matters. Payroll rounds amounts to this many places for payroll areas paid in this currency.

fields.label: CurrencyShortFormEn
fields.html:
What it is. The currency's short form in English.

Example. KWD

Why it matters. Shown next to amounts on reports such as the employee information and basic pay reports, and used in journal vouchers.

fields.label: CurrencyDenominationFormEn
fields.html:
What it is. The currency's denomination form in English.

Why it matters. Not used by any report or calculation at present.

fields.label: CurrencyShortFormAr
fields.html:
What it is. The currency's short form in Arabic.

Example. د.ك

Why it matters. Shown instead of the English short form when a report is produced with Arabic names.

fields.label: CurrencyDenominationFormAr
fields.html:
What it is. The currency's denomination form in Arabic.

Why it matters. Not used by any report or calculation at present.
